_comment: The CEO agent picks ONE offer per lead. Prices are the opening ask, not the floor.

offers.name: Cinematic scroll-driven website
offers.delivery: 10k-websites skill: one AI-generated hero video that scrubs with scroll, then a real site below it. Ships in days, not weeks.
offers.idealClient: A business with revenue and a website that looks like 2012, or no website at all. Restaurants, clinics, law firms, studios, hotels, trades, boutique agencies.
buyingSignals: no website tag on their OSM entry but a phone number listed
site is a Facebook page, Linktree, or a template with stock photos
no HTTPS, not mobile responsive, or a dead domain
they spend on ads but land traffic on something ugly
disqualifiers: already has a strong custom site
wants it for free or under $500
offers.proofNeeded: One live cinematic site to link. Build your own portfolio site first, then a spec demo for the specific prospect.

offers.name: AI workflow automation
offers.delivery: Automate the repetitive middle of their business: lead intake and routing, quote and invoice generation, support triage, reporting, data entry between tools they already pay for.
offers.idealClient: 5-50 person business where somebody's whole job is copying data between two systems. Agencies, clinics, logistics, e-commerce ops, property management.
buyingSignals: hiring for a 'coordinator' or 'ops associate' whose JD is mostly manual data movement
job posts mentioning Zapier, Make, Airtable, HubSpot, spreadsheets as core duties
public complaints about slow response times
they run on 6+ SaaS tools that clearly do not talk to each other
disqualifiers: no budget authority in the conversation
wants a full-time employee, not a system
needs on-prem or heavy compliance you cannot meet
offers.proofNeeded: A 2-minute Loom of a working automation solving THEIR named problem. Build the demo before the call, not after.
offers.leadTime: 2-4 weeks to first working system, then retainer

offers.name: Custom AI agent build
offers.delivery: Bespoke agent: internal copilot over their docs and data, customer-facing assistant, research or analysis agent. Built on Claude, with tool use, evals, and a real handoff.
offers.idealClient: Funded startup or a mid-size company with a technical buyer who has already tried ChatGPT and hit its limits.
buyingSignals: hiring an 'AI engineer' or 'founding engineer, AI' and struggling to fill it
posts on HN Who-is-hiring mentioning LLM, RAG, agents, Claude, or OpenAI
recently raised, shipping fast, small team
asking publicly how to get an LLM to do X reliably
disqualifiers: wants you to build a ChatGPT wrapper for $500
offers.proofNeeded: This system itself. You built a multi-agent CEO that runs your own business development. That is the portfolio piece.

scoring._comment: The qualifier scores 0-100. A lead under minScoreToResearch is left alone.
